mapper.sql: select pa.position_assignment_id as "positionAssignmentId", pa.position_code as "positionCode", pa.user_id as "userId", kps.name as "userName", pa.organization_code as "organizationCode", o.organization_name as "organizationName", pa.effective_start_date as "effectiveStartDate", pa.effective_end_date as "effectiveEndDate", case when pa.status = 'DELETED' then 'DELETED' when pa.effective_end_date is not null and pa.effective_end_date < CURRENT_DATE then 'EXPIRED' else 'ACTIVE' end as "status", pa.confirmed_at as "confirmedAt", pa.change_reason as "changeReason", pa.updated_at as "updatedAt" from position_assignments pa join users u on u.user_id = pa.user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no join organizations o on o.organization_code = pa.organization_code
mapper.select:
pa.status != 'DELETED'
and pa.effective_start_date <= #{criteria.referenceDate} and (pa.effective_end_date is null or pa.effective_end_date >= #{criteria.referenceDate})
and (pa.position_code like concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or pa.organization_code like concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or kps.name like concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%'))
order by pa.confirmed_at desc, pa.position_assignment_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
